title: Worship
definition: Worship is the reverent response of the heart and life to God's worth, glory, grace, truth, and saving work.
summary: Worship is giving God the honor, trust, obedience, and praise He alone deserves.
christFocus: Jesus makes true worship possible by reconciling sinners to God and teaching them to worship the Father in spirit and truth.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Biblical worship is more than singing, though singing is a precious expression of it. Worship is the whole-life response of God's people to His glory, holiness, mercy, and truth.

True worship is centered on God, shaped by Scripture, and made possible through Christ. It includes praise, obedience, surrender, gratitude, reverence, and love.

Worship forms the heart. What people worship shapes what they value, pursue, fear, and trust. The believer is called away from idols and into joyful devotion to the living God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People were created to worship, but sin turns worship toward created things. This doctrine matters because false worship enslaves the heart, while true worship reorders life around God's glory.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Offer God more than words. Worship Him through prayer, obedience, generosity, service, holiness, and praise. Ask what your life is treating as ultimate and turn from idols to the Lord.
